Interaction Description: Tyr192 hydroxyl donates a hydrogen bond to the amide carbonyl oxygen.
The amide NH donates a hydrogen bond to Tyr192 side chain.
Asn191 donates a hydrogen bond to the amide carbonyl oxygen.
Glu151 accepts a hydrogen bond from the protonated nitrogen of the lower benzimidazole.
The N-H of the lower benzimidazole donates a hydrogen bond to Glu152.
Sulfur linking the central chain to the lower benzimidazole forms a directed interaction (chalcogen bond) with Glu152.
Asp150 forms an anion-pi interaction with the benzene ring of the top benzimidazole moiety.
The benzene ring of the top benzimidazole shows pi-pi stacking with Tyr268.
The methyl substituent on the top benzimidazole makes hydrophobic contact with Tyr268.
The methyl substituent on the bottom benzimidazole makes hydrophobic contact with Phe217.
Visible methyl-substituted benzimidazole moiety in the ligand scaffold; the ligand contains two benzimidazole units connected by an amide-thioether linker.
Visible methyl-substituted protonated benzimidazole moiety; the lower heterocycle is protonated (N+) and participates in key electrostatic contacts with Glu151/Glu152.
